Q: Failure to Detect <img> Tags When Bulk Downloading Copyright-Free Images A:

first turn off JavaScript in web browser and (re)load your page - it will show what requests can get from server (because it can't run JavaScript). If page needs JavaScript to get some data then you may need to use Selenium to control real web browser which can run JavaScript.

Sometimes page may get extra information as JSON data from different URL and you may use DevTools in Chrome/Firefox (tab: network, filter: XHR) to get this URL, and then you can try to use requests to get extra data without loading HTML.

Q: what characters are allowed in google search structured data A:

Exhaustive information on this is surprisingly hard to come by, but the list of characters that may need to be escaped in Structured Data - either by using a backslash or the character's corresponding HTML entity - includes:

Character Escaped form
\ backslash \\
" double quote \"
' apostrophe \'
< less than bracket \<
> greater than bracket \>
& ampersand \&

Obviously this only applies if you're using these characters literally - if you're trying to render HTML, for example, then you wouldn't escape the < and > angle brackets.
